about: Euro trucks Spare Parts LLC established in 2004 is a well-known name in the field of Auto Spare Parts Business .Since then ET is the leading importer and exporter of OEM and replacement parts for European trucks and trailers. We provide full range of engine, gear,clutch,suspension,electrical,body parts and much more for Volvo And Scania trucks.

Over the last 10 years, ET has built an unbeatable position with a loyal customer base of over 1000 plus satisfied customers and multiple dealers by offering extended quality and service with the most economical prices.
